summary: Poe Dam is a concrete gravity hydroelectric diversion dam on the North Fork Feather River in Butte County, California, completed in 1959. It is the lowermost component of Pacific Gas and Electric Company's Feather River Canyon Power Project, a system of 10 hydroelectric stations along the North Fork. The dam is controlled by four radial gates.
one_line: Poe Dam is a 1959 concrete gravity hydroelectric diversion dam on the North Fork Feather River in Butte County, California.
key_facts: Poe Dam is a concrete gravity hydroelectric diversion dam.
Poe Dam is located on the North Fork Feather River in Butte County, California, United States.
Poe Dam is about north of Lake Oroville.
Poe Dam is the lowermost component of the Feather River Canyon Power Project.
The Feather River Canyon Power Project is operated by the Pacific Gas and Electric Company.
The Feather River Canyon Power Project is a system of 10 hydroelectric stations along the North Fork Feather River.
Poe Dam's water flows are controlled by four radial gates.
